# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Import a validated SpiderMonkey 33.1 package, preparing the default package
# from the fixed source recipe when it is absent.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

if(TARGET axmol::spidermonkey)
  return()
endif()

if(ANDROID)
  set(_sm_platform android)
  set(_sm_arch "${CMAKE_ANDROID_ARCH_ABI}")
elseif(APPLE)
  if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "iOS" OR IOS)
    if(CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT MATCHES "[Ss]imulator")
      set(_sm_platform ios-simulator)
    else()
      set(_sm_platform ios)
    endif()
  else()
    set(_sm_platform macos)
  endif()
  if(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
    list(LENGTH CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES _sm_arch_count)
    if(NOT _sm_arch_count EQUAL 1)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey packages contain one architecture. Build each Apple architecture separately with its matching AX_JS_SPIDERMONKEY_ROOT.")
    endif()
    set(_sm_arch "${CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES}")
  else()
    set(_sm_arch "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
  endif()
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey 33.1 JS support currently targets Android, macOS and iOS.")
endif()
if(_sm_arch MATCHES "^(arm64|aarch64|arm64-v8a)$")
  set(_sm_arch arm64)
elseif(_sm_arch MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64)$")
  set(_sm_arch x86_64)
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported SpiderMonkey architecture: '${_sm_arch}'. Supported: arm64, x86_64.")
endif()
if(_sm_platform STREQUAL "ios" AND NOT _sm_arch STREQUAL "arm64")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "iOS device SpiderMonkey packages require arm64.")
endif()

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/prepare-package.cmake")
_ax_sm_resolve_package()
file(READ "${_sm_package_root}/manifest.json" _sm_manifest)
function(_ax_sm_json output)
  string(JSON _value ERROR_VARIABLE _error GET "${_sm_manifest}" ${ARGN})
  if(_error)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Invalid SpiderMonkey manifest field '${ARGN}': ${_error}")
  endif()
  set(${output} "${_value}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_ax_sm_expect expected)
  _ax_sm_json(_actual ${ARGN})
  if(NOT "${_actual}" STREQUAL "${expected}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey manifest mismatch for '${ARGN}': expected '${expected}', got '${_actual}'. Rebuild the package for this configuration.")
  endif()
endfunction()
_ax_sm_expect(1 schema_version)
_ax_sm_expect(spidermonkey runtime)
_ax_sm_expect(33.1.1 version)
_ax_sm_expect(1d8c1d7eb188db095b5a7ce838ba0a933a0d414b source_commit)
_ax_sm_expect(7d0d87f5cafe4a9d547eaac2a03b9f01c34bd5c7d93416110719b3b330465764 source_archive_sha256)
_ax_sm_expect("${_sm_platform}" platform)
_ax_sm_expect("${_sm_arch}" architecture)
_ax_sm_expect(c++11 build_standard)
_ax_sm_expect(c++23 consumer_standard)
_ax_sm_expect(ON gc exact_rooting)
_ax_sm_expect(ON gc generational)
_ax_sm_expect(ON gc incremental)

file(GLOB _sm_patches "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/patches/*.patch")
list(SORT _sm_patches)
set(_sm_patch_bytes "")
foreach(_patch IN LISTS _sm_patches)
  get_filename_component(_name "${_patch}" NAME)
  file(READ "${_patch}" _bytes)
  string(APPEND _sm_patch_bytes "${_name}${_bytes}")
endforeach()
string(SHA256 _sm_patch_sha256 "${_sm_patch_bytes}")
_ax_sm_expect("${_sm_patch_sha256}" patch_sha256)

set(_sm_jit OFF)
if((_sm_platform STREQUAL "macos" OR _sm_platform STREQUAL "android") AND _sm_arch STREQUAL "x86_64")
  set(_sm_jit ON)
endif()
_ax_sm_expect("${_sm_jit}" jit)
_ax_sm_expect(lib/libjs_static.a library)
foreach(_part IN ITEMS library config_header)
  _ax_sm_json(_expected "${_part}_sha256")
  if(_part STREQUAL "library")
    set(_file "${_sm_package_root}/lib/libjs_static.a")
  else()
    set(_file "${_sm_package_root}/include/js-config.h")
  endif()
  if(NOT EXISTS "${_file}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey package file missing: ${_file}")
  endif()
  file(SHA256 "${_file}" _actual)
  if(NOT _actual STREQUAL _expected)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey package checksum mismatch: ${_file}. Header and library packages must not be mixed.")
  endif()
endforeach()

_ax_sm_json(_sm_minimum minimum_system_version)
if(ANDROID)
  _ax_sm_expect(c++_shared cxx_abi)
  _ax_sm_expect(27.3.13750724 ndk)
  if(_sm_android_api VERSION_LESS _sm_minimum)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey Android package needs API ${_sm_minimum} or newer.")
  endif()
else()
  _ax_sm_expect(libc++ cxx_abi)
  if(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET AND CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET VERSION_LESS _sm_minimum)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey package minimum system version is ${_sm_minimum}; CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET is ${CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}. Rebuild with the application's deployment target.")
  endif()
endif()

set(_sm_definitions STATIC_JS_API=1 JSGC_INCREMENTAL=1 JSGC_GENERATIONAL=1 JSGC_USE_EXACT_ROOTING=1)
if(ANDROID)
  list(APPEND _sm_definitions ANDROID=1)
elseif(_sm_platform MATCHES "^ios")
  list(APPEND _sm_definitions IPHONEOS=1)
endif()
string(JSON _sm_count ERROR_VARIABLE _error LENGTH "${_sm_manifest}" compile_definitions)
if(_error)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey manifest has no compile_definitions array")
endif()
list(LENGTH _sm_definitions _sm_expected_count)
if(NOT _sm_count EQUAL _sm_expected_count)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "SpiderMonkey public compile definitions do not match the supported ABI.")
endif()
math(EXPR _sm_last "${_sm_count} - 1")
foreach(_index RANGE 0 ${_sm_last})
  list(GET _sm_definitions ${_index} _definition)
  _ax_sm_expect("${_definition}" compile_definitions ${_index})
endforeach()
if(_sm_jit)
  list(APPEND _sm_definitions AX_JS_SPIDERMONKEY_JIT=1)
else()
  list(APPEND _sm_definitions AX_JS_SPIDERMONKEY_JIT=0)
endif()

# Publish only a validated resolved path; leave the public override empty when
# the normal dependency cache is in use, including across reconfiguration.
set(AX_JS_SPIDERMONKEY_RESOLVED_ROOT "${_sm_package_root}" CACHE INTERNAL "Validated SpiderMonkey package" FORCE)

add_library(ax_spidermonkey STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
add_library(axmol::spidermonkey ALIAS ax_spidermonkey)
set_target_properties(ax_spidermonkey PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_LOCATION "${_sm_package_root}/lib/libjs_static.a"
  INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_sm_package_root}/include"
  INTERFACE_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "${_sm_definitions}"
)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(ax_spidermonkey INTERFACE Threads::Threads z)
if(ANDROID)
  target_link_libraries(ax_spidermonkey INTERFACE log)
  target_link_options(ax_spidermonkey INTERFACE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384")
endif()
message(STATUS "SpiderMonkey 33.1: ${_sm_platform}/${_sm_arch}, JIT=${_sm_jit}, package=${_sm_package_root}")
